<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F5F6"/>

  <g font-family="Inter, Arial, sans-serif">
    <!-- Status bar -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="32" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="21" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">9:41</text>
    <line x1="330" y1="18" x2="330" y2="12" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="335" y1="18" x2="335" y2="10" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="340" y1="18" x2="340" y2="8" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="353" cy="14" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="19" x2="358" y2="19" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="367" y="9" width="18" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#1F2125" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="369" y="11" width="13" height="7" rx="1" fill="#1F2125"/>
    <rect x="385" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#1F2125"/>

    <!-- Underlying app header -->
    <rect x="0" y="32" width="390" height="72" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="20" y="68" font-size="24" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Community</text>
    <circle cx="349" cy="67" r="20" fill="#B8EDDC"/>
    <text x="349" y="72" text-anchor="middle" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#009A67">JR</text>
    <circle cx="365" cy="51" r="5" fill="#ED5555"/>
    <line x1="20" y1="104" x2="370" y2="104" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>

    <!-- Search -->
    <rect x="20" y="120" width="350" height="48" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="141" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="47" y1="147" x2="53" y2="153" stroke="#878B90" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="66" y="147" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#878B90">Search discussions</text>

    <text x="20" y="200" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Latest activity</text>
    <text x="318" y="200" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#4367BC">See all</text>

    <!-- Background feed cards -->
    <rect x="20" y="216" width="350" height="92" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="20" y="214" width="350" height="92" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="244" r="18" fill="#D8E0F3"/>
    <text x="48" y="249" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#4367BC">AM</text>
    <text x="78" y="239" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Aisha Morgan</text>
    <text x="78" y="258" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#878B90">2 hours ago · Product design</text>
    <text x="38" y="286" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#45484C">How do you keep research notes organized?</text>

    <rect x="20" y="320" width="350" height="92" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="20" y="318" width="350" height="92" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="348" r="18" fill="#B7E8A6"/>
    <text x="48" y="353" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#31BD00">DK</text>
    <text x="78" y="343" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Daniel Kim</text>
    <text x="78" y="362" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#878B90">Yesterday · Growth</text>
    <text x="38" y="390" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#45484C">Sharing our latest onboarding checklist.</text>

    <rect x="20" y="424" width="350" height="92" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity="0.08"/>
    <rect x="20" y="422" width="350" height="92" rx="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <circle cx="48" cy="452" r="18" fill="#FFF3A6"/>
    <text x="48" y="457" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="600" fill="#D6B900">LS</text>
    <text x="78" y="447" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Laura Singh</text>
    <text x="78" y="466" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#878B90">Mon, Jun 15 · Community</text>
    <text x="38" y="494" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#45484C">Three lessons from our member meetup.</text>

    <!-- Bottom navigation -->
    <rect x="0" y="764" width="390" height="80" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="764" x2="390" y2="764" stroke="#D9D9D9" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g fill="#878B90" stroke="#878B90">
      <polygon points="39,790 49,782 59,790 59,803 39,803" fill="none" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polyline points="35,790 49,779 63,790" fill="none" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="49" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90" stroke="none">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g fill="#878B90" stroke="#878B90">
      <circle cx="128" cy="790" r="9" fill="none" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <line x1="135" y1="797" x2="142" y2="804" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="128" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90" stroke="none">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="195" cy="794" r="23" fill="#009A67"/>
      <line x1="195" y1="785" x2="195" y2="803" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="186" y1="794" x2="204" y2="794" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="195" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#009A67">Create</text>
    </g>
    <g fill="#878B90" stroke="#878B90">
      <rect x="260" y="782" width="20" height="15" rx="4" fill="none" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <polygon points="264,797 264,802 270,797" fill="none" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text x="270" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90" stroke="none">Inbox</text>
    </g>
    <g fill="#878B90" stroke="#878B90">
      <circle cx="334" cy="787" r="6" fill="none" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <ellipse cx="334" cy="802" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke-width="1.8"/>
      <text x="334" y="828" text-anchor="middle" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90" stroke="none">Profile</text>
    </g>

    <!-- Dimmed overlay -->
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#1F2125" opacity="0.68"/>

    <!-- Modal shadow and card -->
    <rect x="21" y="235" width="348" height="374" rx="16" fill="#000000" opacity="0.25"/>
    <rect x="20" y="232" width="350" height="374" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <!-- Modal close -->
    <circle cx="341" cy="263" r="15" fill="#F3F5F6"/>
    <line x1="336" y1="258" x2="346" y2="268" stroke="#585C62" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="346" y1="258" x2="336" y2="268" stroke="#585C62" stroke-width="1.8"/>

    <text x="44" y="280" font-size="24" font-weight="600" fill="#1F2125">Choose an action</text>
    <text x="44" y="309" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#45484C">Make your next move</text>
    <text x="44" y="334" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">Select an option below to continue</text>
    <text x="44" y="353" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#777777">in the community.</text>

    <!-- Action buttons -->
    <g>
      <rect x="44" y="374" width="302" height="56" rx="16" fill="#009A67"/>
      <text x="195" y="408" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Create a post</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="44" y="442" width="302" height="56" rx="16" fill="#D8E0F3"/>
      <text x="195" y="476" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#4367BC">Share feedback</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="44" y="510" width="302" height="56" rx="16" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B2B5BB" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text x="195" y="544" text-anchor="middle" font-size="16" font-weight="500" fill="#1F2125">Invite members</text>
    </g>
    <text x="195" y="588" text-anchor="middle" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#878B90">You can change this later</text>
  </g>
</svg>
